answer: Each identity is registered to one hardware credential and must post a bond of 400 nectar tokens locked for 20 epochs, recorded in a registry that serves as a bridge across operators. Copying a credential or registering a second one requires locking an additional 400 tokens per identity for the full epoch wait. Any credential detected on two identities is slashed 100 percent across all bonded records, so each fake identity raises marginal cost by the full bond and one dune of detected collusion forfeits every linked stake.
